experiences.title: Data Engineer
experiences.description:
Built PySpark and Databricks pipelines processing more than 12 billion monthly records, reducing machine learning feature preparation time by 55% across forecasting and behavioral analytics workloads.

Partnered with data scientists and analytics engineers to deliver curated machine learning datasets within Snowflake environments, reducing model training preparation efforts by 48% across forecasting initiatives.
Developed LLM-powered RAG solutions using Azure OpenAI and Vector Databases, improving contextual data retrieval accuracy by 42% and accelerating enterprise analytics insights.
